what: integrate-store: 00999 is written but unbuilt; please build and test blaze-core and blaze-cas on Linux (uring), macOS (kqueue) and Windows (iocp; this is the first use of windows-sys Win32_Security_Authorization, which blaze-core/Cargo.toml adds on top of the workspace features).
